[LUNI.11.4.1] Label strings are **display-plane only**. On builds with no
interpolation surface — e.g. `nofpu` embedded targets where the
runtime omits the format-string lowering to save flash / RAM, or any
target with `display_strip` opt-in — the lowering pass drops every
declared `label` string from the emitted DSC; bare unit symbols still
serve as the fallback at interpolation sites when they re-enter. The
strip is a pure tail elision and does not change any
arithmetic or conversion factor.

No build in this edition lacks the interpolation surface, so every build keeps
its labels ([LUNI.11.4]). The strip pairs with the fixed-point storage backing
[LUNI.17.3] proposes for the `nofpu` targets.
